metadata.title: Local Combinatorial Criteria for Geometric Hyper-ideal Triangulations via Combinatorial Ricci Flow
metadata.abstract: We give local combinatorial criteria for realizing prescribed ideal triangulations by nondegenerate hyperbolic truncated tetrahedra. A local bichromatic criterion allows valence-7 edges when tetrahedra meeting low-valence edges use at most two quotient-edge classes. Using the extended combinatorial Ricci flow, we obtain parameter-dependent criteria for triangulations of minimum valence 6. Symmetric and pair-min angle estimates yield explicit valence conditions, including mixed conditions on entire edge stars. The proofs use analytic angle inequalities and rigorous interval evaluations. Explicit face pairings realize the criteria and distinguish their scope, while cyclic constructions and finite covers give infinite families. Each criterion yields a unique zero-curvature hyper-ideal metric and exponential convergence from any positive initial length vector.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 提出实现双曲截断四面体理想剖分的局部组合判据，允许某些价七边并给出最小价六情形的参数条件；取得零曲率 hyper-ideal 度量唯一性及指数收敛。
analysis.breakthrough: 用局部边星条件构造无限可几何化族。
analysis.limitations: 各判据适用范围不同，须避免把某一局部条件推广为全部剖分。 当前为摘要级数学解读；AI 披露另行做独立全文核查，尚未核验的记录不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 协助搜索具体剖分例、准备图形和严格数值评估代码、检查参考文献、翻译及编辑；所有例子、代码和图形经作者核验，不推断一般定理证明由 AI 给出。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.34108v1 · 第 2 页 AI assistance

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 ChatGPT 协助搜索具体剖分例、准备图形和严格数值评估代码、检查参考文献、翻译及编辑；所有例子、代码和图形经作者核验，不推断一般定理证明由 AI 给出。

analysis.priorityReason: 把几何化存在性转化为组合可检验条件。
